title: Jabberwocky's Diagram: The Warehouse Unveiled
summary: Nightly, a warehouse held a horrible problem, a thorn in its bricked operations. A waitress with raunchy gelato, a pelican, and a pram, all seemed to guard a hallowed chalice. Our cool protagonist, a learner, with a pretty smile, felt a pulse of urgency. Stricken by what they saw, they navigated a highrise labyrinth, a valiant vulture circling. They dodged pleasant gimmicks, the amberjack's fate a stark warning. The immortal quest, fueled by a jaunty spirit in leggings, led them to a dicky, mudflap-covered chapbook. A vehement parasite diagram, a jabberwocky from hell, was revealed. With a lance and whiplash speed, the climax arrived. Companioned, no longer deluded, they faced the irony. Gunpowder and liftoff had changed everything. A reader, a gobbler, and a warning now offered comfort, a new dedication. The hungover bumpkin found peace.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: Nightly, a warehouse operations problem began.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a dimly lit, vast industrial warehouse interior at nightly twilight. The scene is dominated by stacks of bricked-up storage units and the distant glow of a single billiards table. A teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, is seen from behind, facing away from the viewer, a single mechanical bolt clutched in their hand. A distant, pretty waitress serves raunchy gelato to a phantom pelican pushing a pram, casting a horrible shadow near a hallowed alcove. The air is cool, but a thorn of a problem pricks the scene. Concept art, vibrant high-contrast, Moebius aesthetic, warm golden hour lighting.

The teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, is visible, now companied by a weary reader. They are handpicked survivors, no longer deluded, but with a haunted understanding. Empty lockers and alcopop bottles are scattered.
